findings.title: history_base extractor ignores SessionMeta field, causing false absence and false-positive evidence check
findings.description: All 12 C source snapshots contain session_meta.payload.history_base {thread_id:A,end_ordinal_exclusive:83,end_byte_offset:491301}, while sourceEvidence only selects top-level type=history_base. Summaries incorrectly emit [], check.cjs:33 passes that omission, and report.md:23 incorrectly states history_base absent. Actual source headers/hashes and cut metadata contradict the byte-intact summaries. This changes the Branch/source evidence interpretation without making C a resend or proving product publication.
findings.recommended_repair: Append-only offline extraction, corrected summary/report and necessary self-check from retained private snapshots; preserve all original files/events/blob hashes and failures; no product source, new model turn, device/service rerun or resource changes.
